title: Prepare for Slovakia's e-invoicing requirements
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Built for Slovakia's Five-Corner Peppol Model


Slovakia's model demands that each invoice be validated once and reported cleanly, without the authority sitting in the delivery path. The invoice flows peer-to-peer through the four Peppol corners, while a fifth corner sends the data to the tax authority in near real time. A Tax Data Document (TDD) is generated from each invoice and reported to the Financial Administration, consolidating them into a single real-time stream.


Vertex enables your organization to:


###


Validate invoices before delivery, preventing rejection and unreported transactions.


###


Align to Peppol formats and routing, avoiding delayed payment.


###


Generate a compliant TDD from each invoice, cutting reporting gaps.


###


Consolidate control statement and sales list filings, reducing manual effort.
